evidence.finding: candidate aiv_vec_ratio mean 0.846, of which aiv_vec_misc_ratio mean 0.798 (fp16 0.0253, int32 0.0227); MTE2/MTE3 ratio only 0.041/0.047; Task Duration 269.07 us for 1152 blocks. Vector-pipe 'misc' (data permutation/slice) work, not arithmetic, dominates.

tl.join(even, odd)+tl.reshape lowers to two tensor.insert_slice ops writing into a tensor<16x128x2xf16> with inner stride 2 (lines 'inserted_slice' / 'inserted_slice_8', for both pe and po) followed by tensor.reshape; i.e. the even/odd interleave is done as four strided vector copies inside UB, counted as vector 'misc' work, before the contiguous store.

Per-instruction hotspots on _blk2x_kernel/core0.veccore0: the largest single-instruction times sit on line 137 (tl.reshape(tl.join(even_f, odd_f))) - four BAR/WAIT_FLAG entries with 21 calls each at 101.98/101.93/101.49/101.41 us and three more at 74.6/73.2/72.9 us - plus four BARs at 80.3 us on the gather lines 133-135 (336 calls). Region 108-175 has trace_interval_union 304 us of a 319 us capture.

Exact-2x fast path currently: vertical mix -> two tl.gather horizontal neighbours -> four madds -> tl.join + tl.reshape to (QB, OW) -> two contiguous stores (masked form for b == 0). The interleave is the only remaining bulk permutation besides the four gathers.
knowledge retrieval is empty (exact 0, type_transfer 0); no specialized record exists for this operator, so only this workspace's evidence is used.

hypothesis: On the fixed 4x32x128x128 -> 256x256 FP16 case the fast path is vector-pipe bound by 'misc' permutation work (aiv_vec_misc_ratio 0.798 out of aiv_vec_ratio 0.846), not by fp16 arithmetic (0.025). Half of that permutation volume is the even/odd interleave that tl.join+tl.reshape compiles to four stride-2 tensor.insert_slice copies in UB (8192 of ~16384 permuted elements per program), and the simulator attributes the largest per-instruction times to exactly those line-137 BARs. Since the output elements are already produced as separate even-column (2k) and odd-column (2k+1) tiles, the interleave can be expressed purely in the store addressing: two strided column stores per output row instead of one contiguous store of an interleaved tile.
alternatives: The same latency could be limited by the four tl.gather horizontal-neighbour tiles rather than by the join; those are not touched by this change and their BARs would remain if the join is the smaller share.
Strided (stride-2, 2-byte-element) GM writes might be lowered to an inefficient element-wise path, in which case the interleave cost moves to MTE3/vector instead of disappearing.
discriminating_observation: If misc-bounded interleave dominates, aiv_vec_misc_ratio must drop clearly (>=0.1 absolute) while aiv_mte3_time / UB_to_GM_datas grow only mildly; if instead the gathers dominate, aiv_vec_misc_ratio stays near 0.80 and Task Duration is roughly unchanged.
change: In _blk2x_kernel only (the exact-2x fast path, which covers the fixed case): keep the vertical mix, the two tl.gather neighbour tiles and the four madds bit-identically, but delete pe = reshape(join(even_f, odd_f), (QB, OW)) and po likewise, and store the four (QB, IW) tiles directly at even-column offsets 2*k and odd-column offsets 2*k+1 of output rows 2*(lb+r)+2 and 2*(lb+r)+1, with the same b == 0 row mask. No arithmetic, indexing rule, dtype handling, gate condition, cache/launch mechanism or other kernel (_bilinear_int_kernel, _bilinear_flat_kernel, plan gating, host path) changes.
expected: aiv_vec_misc_ratio falls from ~0.80 toward ~0.4-0.5, aiv_vec_time per block falls, aiv_mte3_time/UB_to_GM_datas rise (strided writes, from ~0.31 us to at most a few us per block), and the fixed-case Task Duration drops from 269.07 us (target: measurable decrease, e.g. <=240 us). Numerical output identical in structure (same per-output arithmetic), so all 24 formal cases and both 30-case supplementary suites must still match.
validation: Preflight (compile + read-only admission + supplementary checks) on candidate.py, then the host's full KGS formal evaluation and supplementary suites; compare Task Duration, aiv_vec_misc_ratio, aiv_vec_time and aiv_mte3_time against the recorded 269.07 us / 0.798 / 9.13 us / 0.307 us baselines, and require every fixed and supplementary case to pass unchanged.
unknown: How Triton/Ascend lowers a stride-2 fp16 store of an affine (QB, IW) offset tile: descriptor DMA (cheap) or element-wise scatter (expensive).
How much of the 336-call gather BAR time is genuinely serial versus overlapped; the change does not address the gathers.
Whether host-side launch latency is a material share of the 269 us device task on this case; the paired evidence only reports the kernel task duration.
